{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Hypothesis: weighting existing valid sampled pairs by detached softmax negative scores emphasizes competitive negatives and may improve HR@10. Only the loss changes; sampling, GRU architecture, inference, and training settings remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"def bpr_sequence_loss(model: nn.Module, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    mask = (pos != 0).float()
    loss = -torch.log(torch.sigmoid(pos_scores - neg_scores) + 1e-8)
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)","replace":"def bpr_sequence_loss(model: nn.Module, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    mask = pos != 0
    if not mask.any():
        return pos_scores.sum() * 0.0
    valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()"}]}],"change_summary":"Replace uniform BPR with hard-negative-weighted pairwise logistic loss over existing valid sampled pairs across the batch. No predictor changes are required."}
